title: Launch ambassador kits and live demo scripts for Sales & CS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, reproducible enablement deliverable set ("Ambassador Kit") for Sales + Customer Success that covers new feature launch release notes, persona-specific battlecards, objection handling, talk tracks, and live demo scripts. Coordinate with engineering, docs, design, and marketing to lock final messaging, gather assets, and schedule two live training sessions and one recorded walkthrough. Deliverables should be lightweight (one-page battlecards per persona, 5-minute demo scripts, FAQ cheat sheet, annotated release notes summary) so reps can internalize within one 60-minute session.
acceptance_criteria: One-page battlecards for three personas (Platform Engineer, ML/Applied Engineer, Product Manager) finalized and approved
Two 60-minute live enablement sessions scheduled and staffed with Product + Solutions Engineer
Three demo scripts (quick-start, advanced cost/perf tuning, failure-recovery) written and validated against staging environment
Release notes one-page summary drafted and linked to official release notes; change log entries verified by Engineering
FAQ cheat sheet (top 20 Qs) created and reviewed by Support & Legal
Upload of all artifacts to Drive + Confluence and an internal announcement draft ready for comms
